verdict.rationale: Discord is a SaaS communication platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack has no official MCP server or MCP endpoint. The REST API, Gateway, bot tokens, and llms.txt/markdown docs are developer building blocks and AI-readable docs, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
